title: Workshops
description: Plan workshops, send contracts and follow each one from signature to gallery.
newDescription: Fill in the workshop once. The contract is made from it and emailed to the instructor when you save.
editDescription: Changes to fields marked with the link icon also change the contract.

table.searchPlaceholder: Search by title, instructor or place…

first.title: No workshops yet
first.description: Create your first workshop. We’ll prepare the contract and email it to the instructor for you.

upcoming.title: Nothing coming up
upcoming.description: There are no upcoming workshops right now. How about planning the next one?

awaiting_signature.title: No contracts waiting
awaiting_signature.description: Every instructor has signed. Nice work!

published.title: No open registrations
published.description: Workshops appear here once their instructor signs the contract.

confirmed.title: No confirmed workshops
confirmed.description: Workshops appear here after you confirm them at the go / no-go decision.

cancelled.title: No cancelled workshops
cancelled.description: Good news: nothing has been cancelled.

closed.title: No closed workshops yet
closed.description: Workshops appear here after they are closed on their finances page.

all.title: No workshops
all.description: Create your first workshop to get started.

prerequisites.title: A few things first
prerequisites.description: Every workshop needs a category, an instructor and the contract text. Once these are ready, you can create workshops.

form.lockedTitle: Contract terms can’t change any more
form.lockedDescription: This workshop is cancelled or closed, so the date, place, capacity and fee stay as they are. You can still edit the texts and photos.

basics.title: The workshop
basics.description: Its name in every language, its category and who teaches it.

when.title: Date and time
when.description: When it takes place, until when people can register, and when you decide whether it goes ahead.

where.title: Place and participants
where.description: Where it happens, who it’s for and how many people can join.

price.title: Price and terms
price.description: What one place costs and which registration terms people accept.

about.title: About the workshop
about.description: What visitors read on the workshop page. Short, friendly sentences work best.

photos.title: Photos
photos.description: A cover photo and a few pictures of work made in this workshop.

contract.title: Instructor contract
contract.description: How the instructor is paid. These details go into the contract with the workshop details.
contract.markHint: Fields with this mark appear in the contract.

reissue.title: These changes update the contract
reissue.sent: Contract version {version} hasn’t been signed yet. When you save, it is replaced by a new version and emailed to the instructor again.
reissue.signed: Contract version {version} is already signed. When you save, it is replaced by a new version, and the workshop is hidden from the site until the instructor signs again.
reissue.confirmDescription: We’ll replace the current contract with version {version} and email it to {name}. Until it’s signed, the workshop waits for the signature and doesn’t show on the site. People who already registered keep their places.

fields.title: Workshop name
fields.instructorHint: The contract is emailed to this instructor.
fields.slugHint: Part of the workshop’s link. It’s made from the Turkish name; change it only if you need to.
fields.registrationDeadlineHint: Registration closes on its own at this time
fields.decisionAtHint: We’ll email you then with the number of registrations
fields.priceHint: In Turkish lira, for one place.
fields.priceLocked: {count, plural, one {# person has} other {# people have}} already registered at this price, so it can’t be changed.
fields.termsHint: People accept these terms when they register.
fields.introPlaceholder: What will participants make or learn?
fields.bringNothingHint: Participants don’t need to bring anything.
fields.bringPlaceholder: e.g. An apron and a small towel
fields.bringHint: Also sent in the reminder email.
fields.experienceHint: Turn on if participants need to know something already.
fields.notesHint: Only for anything that doesn’t fit above.
fields.coverHint: Shown at the top of the workshop page and in lists. A wide photo works best.
fields.samplesHint: Up to 12 photos of pieces made in this workshop.

feeTypes.per_participantHint: An amount for each participant, counted at the go / no-go decision.
feeTypes.fixedHint: One amount for the whole workshop, however many people come.

fields.feeAtFullCapacity: With a full workshop this comes to {amount}.
fields.hasAdvanceHint: Part of the fee paid before the workshop, deducted at settlement.

validation.maxBelowMin: The maximum can’t be less than the minimum.
validation.deadlineBeforeStart: Registration has to close before the workshop starts.
validation.decisionBeforeStart: The decision has to come before the workshop starts.
validation.ageRange: The upper age can’t be less than the lower age.
validation.advanceRequired: Please enter the advance amount, or turn off the advance payment.
validation.advanceTooBig: The advance can’t be more than the total fee (for a per-participant fee: the amount times the maximum participants).
validation.startInFuture: Please choose a date and time in the future.

toast.created: Workshop created. The contract is on its way to {name}.
toast.createdNoEmail: Workshop created, but we couldn’t email the contract. You can send it again from the Contract tab.
toast.reissued: Changes saved. Contract version {version} is on its way to {name}.
toast.reissuedNoEmail: Changes saved and contract version {version} is ready, but we couldn’t email it. You can send it again from the Contract tab.

errors.slugTaken: Another workshop already uses this page address. Please choose a different one.
errors.choiceGone: One of the options you chose no longer exists. Please choose again.
errors.noContractTemplate: There’s no default contract text yet. Please set it in Templates first.
errors.instructorUnavailable: This instructor isn’t active. Please choose another one.
errors.contractLocked: This workshop is cancelled or closed, so its date, place, capacity, instructor and fee can’t change.
errors.priceLocked: People have already registered at this price, so it can’t be changed.
errors.capacityBelowRegistrations: {count, plural, one {# person has} other {# people have}} already registered, so the maximum can’t be lower than that.
errors.cannotConfirm: Only a workshop that is open for registration can be confirmed.
errors.alreadyStarted: This workshop has already started, so it can’t be confirmed any more.
errors.cannotCancel: This workshop is already cancelled or closed.
errors.galleryClosedOnly: Photos and videos can be added once the workshop is closed.
errors.mediaInUse: One of these files is already used elsewhere. Please upload it again.

overview.minimum: {count, plural, one {Needs at least # person} other {Needs at least # people}}
overview.pending: {count, plural, one {# more is paying} other {# more are paying}}
overview.final: {count, plural, one {Final number: # participant} other {Final number: # participants}}

awaiting.title: Waiting for {name} to sign
awaiting.text: Contract version {version} was emailed on {date}. The workshop goes live on the site as soon as it’s signed.
awaiting.noContract: There’s no contract to sign. Edit the workshop and save to send a new one.

published.title: Registration is open
published.dueTitle: Time for the go / no-go decision
published.text: Registration closes {deadline}, and the decision is due {decision}. So far {confirmed, plural, =0 {nobody has} one {# person has} other {# people have}} registered; the minimum is {minimum}.

confirmed.title: Confirmed: it’s happening!
confirmed.text: {count, plural, one {# participant is} other {# participants are}} coming on {date}.

held.title: Time to close the workshop
held.text: Add the expenses and close the workshop on its finances page. The figures are locked when you close it.

cancelled.title: This workshop was cancelled
cancelled.text: Cancelled on {date}. {count, plural, =0 {There were no registrations to cancel.} one {# registration was cancelled; if they had paid, they get a full refund.} other {# registrations were cancelled; everyone who paid gets a full refund.}}

closed.title: Closed. Now the photos!
closed.text: Add the photos and videos, and the workshop appears among the past workshops.
closed.textDone: {count, plural, one {# photo or video is} other {# photos and videos are}} in the gallery.

confirm.title: Confirm “{title}”?
confirm.description: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody has registered yet.} one {# person has registered.} other {# people have registered.}} This becomes the final number of participants, and the instructor’s fee is based on it.
confirm.belowMinimum: This is below the minimum of {minimum}.

cancel.title: Cancel “{title}”?
cancel.description: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody has registered yet.} one {# registration will be cancelled.} other {# registrations will be cancelled.}} Everyone who paid gets a full refund and a friendly email. This can’t be undone.

contractPage.preview: Not signed yet. This is the text as the instructor sees it now.

none.title: No contract yet
none.description: A contract is made automatically when the workshop is saved.

noText.title: This version wasn’t signed
noText.description: It stopped being valid before the instructor signed it (a newer version was sent, or the workshop was cancelled), so there’s no signed text to show.

contractPage.howToChange: The contract is made from the workshop details. To change it, edit the workshop: a new version is sent to the instructor.

empty.title: No registrations yet
empty.description: People who register for this workshop appear here.
empty.awaiting: Registration opens once the instructor signs the contract.

registrations.readOnly: To change a registration or a refund, use the Registrations section.

gallery.title: Photos and videos
gallery.description: Photos get the watermark automatically. Drag to change the order.

notYet.title: The gallery opens after the workshop is closed
notYet.description: Close the workshop on its finances page first. Then add photos and videos here.

cancelled.title: No gallery for a cancelled workshop
cancelled.description: This workshop didn’t take place, so it has no photos or videos.

consent.title: Who may be recognisable
consent.description: Only publish photos or videos where people can be recognised if they agreed to it when they registered.
consent.nobody: Nobody attended through a paid registration.
consent.summary: {photos} of {total} agreed to photos, {videos} of {total} to videos.
